items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: the five deliverables of the mini-plan exist: generic writer with CLI and tests, pinned prose read by P8b (and by the replay citations), retag to covers_none tooling, locks written last with approved_deltas [], campaign docs and one hooks-doc paragraph; no live skill prose or product script changed

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: the writer refuses a missing required file, an unreadable REQUIRED, a missing spec and a changed lock without --repin, writing nothing; the CLI maps every ValueError/OSError/SyntaxError to exit 2 with a JSON error

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: test support only, stdlib, no network or secrets; paths outside the repository are refused; residual risk (a diff that re-pins its own hash) stays with review as the freeze test docstring states

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 23 writer tests incl. a literal digest of a fixture lock (equal on 3.11, 3.12, 3.13), CRLF checkout, approved-delta check, promise-only, repin report, refusals; the real-tree check runs in test_trace_freeze.py

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: one plan per CLI call; hashing 95 files and fingerprinting 20 promise tests takes about a second

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: golden_lock.py 249 lines, test file 271 lines, both under 300; ruff clean; pins carry a .pin suffix so the bloat gate and prose scanners do not read them as live skill text

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: producer golden_lock.py -> consumers test_trace_freeze.py (tree_problems, gt.freeze_problems) and promise_lock.lock_problems: round-tripped on the real tree (--check ok, freeze tests green) and on fixture trees with CRLF bytes
